propositions: Mode inherits str, causing functools.total_ordering to not replace str's lexical __gt__, __le__, __ge__ methods, breaking rank-based mode ordering.
Mode.BOOTSTRAP_THROTTLE > Mode.RECONCILE_CHECK incorrectly returns false due to lexical comparison, causing check_phase_gate to fail blocking higher modes.
Rich comparison operators must use the existing _ORDERED rank contract instead of inherited string lexical ordering across all five modes.
Persisted Mode values, equality semantics, MODE_CAPS, from_str behavior, and stored gate strings must remain unchanged after the fix.
Real ref-backed reconcile-check gate round trip must block bootstrap-throttle while allowing reconcile-check as the stored target.
All-pairs five-mode rich comparison coverage (reconcile-check < dry-run < bootstrap-strict < bootstrap-throttle < live) must pass for <, <=, >, >= operators.
